name: cooking-greek
description: Recipe hypergraph from Greek cuisine (Greece). Nodes represent ingredients. Each hyperedge represents a recipe and contains the set of ingredients used in that recipe.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., cooking-greek).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Name of the food ingredient (e.g., romaine lettuce).
